food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Kanwar Yatra Camps Blend Tradition and Street Food With 7,000 Rotis a Day
food.excerpt: Volunteer camps along the Uttar Pradesh pilgrimage route serve everything from shahi paneer and dal makhani to pizza, momos, and pasta — all prepared without onion and garlic.
food.image_caption: Kanwar Yatris carry holy water from the Ganges during the annual pilgrimage. Food camps along the route serve thousands of rotis and traditional street food daily.
food.nri_angle: The Kanwar Yatra is one of India's most iconic religious pilgrimages, and its evolving food culture reflects the broader fusion of tradition and modernity that resonates with the diaspora
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Three Indian Bars Crack Asia's 50 Best List as Goa's Boilermaker Storms Into Top 10
food.excerpt: Boilermaker in Goa jumped 22 places to No. 8, while Bengaluru's SOKA and Bar Spirit Forward reinforced the city's growing reputation as India's cocktail capital.
food.image_caption: The interior of Boilermaker in Siolim, Goa. The bar jumped 22 places to No. 8 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026 and was named Best Bar in India.
food.nri_angle: India's growing presence on the global cocktail stage is a point of pride for NRIs, many of whom visit these bars when traveling home and follow the country's evolving food and drink scene.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Nick and Joe Jonas Snack on Bhajia, Kachori, and Papad During Tour Break
food.excerpt: The Jonas Brothers continue to embrace Indian cuisine on their 20th anniversary tour, with Nick's love for Indian food now a recurring highlight of their social media presence.
food.nri_angle: Nick Jonas's genuine embrace of Indian food and Bollywood culture has made him a beloved figure among the Indian diaspora, turning casual snack moments into cultural touchpoints.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Himachali Siddu: How To Make the Mountain Bread That Fueled Himalayan Shepherds
food.excerpt: This steamed, walnut-stuffed bread from Himachal Pradesh is centuries old, protein-rich, and easy to make at home with just wheat flour, yeast, and a handful of nuts and herbs.
food.image_caption: Siddu, a traditional steamed bread from Himachal Pradesh, is made with wheat dough stuffed with a spiced filling and cooked over a slow flame.
food.nri_angle: Siddu uses pantry staples available worldwide, making it an accessible way for diaspora families to connect with Himachali mountain food traditions at home.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: What Made Your Thali Costlier in July: Onions, Oil, and Chicken Drive Kitchen Inflation
food.excerpt: Home-cooked vegetarian meals rose 4% and non-vegetarian meals 9% year-on-year as onion, oil, LPG, and chicken prices surged, a Crisil report finds.
food.nri_angle: The thali cost index is a useful barometer of food inflation for diaspora families tracking the cost of living back home in India.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: FSSAI Penalises Fortune Oil Maker AWL After Sunflower Oil Fails Vitamin D Test
food.excerpt: India's food safety regulator has taken action against AWL Agri Business, formerly Adani Wilmar, after a Fortune sunflower oil sample did not meet mandatory Vitamin D fortification standards, part of an intensifying crackdown on food labelling and quality.
food.nri_angle: Fortune is widely available in Indian grocery stores across the US, UK and Canada; diaspora consumers buying imported Fortune oil should check fortification labels.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: How Zorawar Kalra Built a Global Indian Restaurant Empire From His Father's Legacy
food.excerpt: The son of legendary food critic Jiggs Kalra reveals how he recruited two of India's best young chefs to launch Masala Library — and turned Indian food into a global brand with 50 restaurants and counting.
food.image_caption: The late Jiggs Kalra, known as the Czar of Indian cuisine, whose culinary legacy his son Zorawar has expanded into a global restaurant empire.
food.nri_angle: Kalra's plan to open 50 restaurants across North America directly targets the Indian diaspora market, filling a gap in casual modern Indian dining that cities like New York, Toronto, and the Bay Area currently lack.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Kolkata's Iconic Flurys Opens First North India Outlet in Gurugram Ahead of Centenary
food.excerpt: The 99-year-old tearoom brings its Park Street heritage to Galleria Market as it eyes a national footprint before its 2027 centenary.
food.image_caption: Flurys, the iconic Kolkata tearoom on Park Street, has opened its first outlet in North India at Gurugram's Galleria Market ahead of its centenary in 2027.
food.nri_angle: For Bengalis and Kolkata natives abroad, Flurys evokes deep nostalgia — its expansion signals that iconic local brands are scaling nationally.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From ICRISAT Lab to Rs 2 Crore Business: The Indian Scientist Behind Edible Spoons
food.excerpt: Narayana Peesapaty quit crop research to build Bakeys, the Hyderabad startup making cutlery from jowar, rice and wheat that you eat after your meal or let decompose in days.
food.image_caption: Bakey's edible cutlery, invented by former ICRISAT scientist Narayana Peesapaty, offers a biodegradable alternative to single-use plastic.
food.nri_angle: The edible cutlery movement combines Indian scientific ingenuity with global sustainability goals, exemplifying the frugal innovation model India is increasingly exporting worldwide.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Kashmir Route Outpaces Manali as Ladakh Tourism Hits 98% of 2025 Total by July
travel.excerpt: Ladakh recorded over 330,000 tourists in seven months, driven by a road network that has more than doubled since 2019 and dramatically reduced seasonal closures.
travel.image_caption: Tourists travel through the Ladakh region. The union territory recorded over 330,000 visitors between January and July 2026, nearly matching the entire previous year's total.
travel.nri_angle: NRI travelers planning a Ladakh trip now have more reliable access through the Kashmir route and an expanding homestay network.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Canada Airports Launch Free Flow Transit, Letting International Passengers Skip Border Checks
travel.excerpt: Toronto Pearson, Vancouver, and Montréal-Trudeau now let connecting international travelers bypass customs entirely, saving up to 60 minutes on layovers.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers routing through Canadian airports to the US will benefit from faster connections, especially on the popular Delhi/Mumbai-Toronto-US corridor.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Japan Orders Mass Evacuations as Typhoon Dolphin Cancels Over 500 Flights
travel.excerpt: The Category 1 storm is bearing down on southwestern Japan with 144 kph winds, forcing 260,000 to evacuate and shuttering Toyota factories. China's eastern coast braces for landfall within days.
travel.image_caption: Typhoon Dolphin approaching southwestern Japan on Friday. The Category 1 storm has forced the evacuation of nearly 260,000 residents across Kagoshima and Okinawa prefectures.
travel.nri_angle: Indian nationals and diaspora travellers in Japan or eastern China should monitor advisories as the storm disrupts flights, rail and ferry services during peak summer travel season.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Ladakh to Launch India's First High-Altitude Wildlife Safari on Snow Leopard Trails
travel.excerpt: The newly constituted SHAN Conservation Society has directed forest officials to introduce guided jeep safaris across Hemis National Park and other protected areas, modeled on Kaziranga and Ranthambore.
travel.image_caption: Ladakh is home to 477 of India's estimated 718 snow leopards and will introduce guided jeep safaris across its high-altitude wildlife trails. The initiative aims to curb illegal off-roading while creating sustainable livelihoods for local communities.
travel.nri_angle: Ladakh's new safari program offers diaspora travelers a structured way to experience India's Himalayan wildlife, adding to the territory's appeal as a bucket-list destination for Indian-Americans and NRI adventurers.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Iberia to Chase the Solar Eclipse at 35,000 Feet in a Historic First
travel.excerpt: The Spanish airline will fly an Airbus A321XLR above the clouds on August 12 to observe Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century, livestreaming the event globally via Starlink.
travel.image_caption: An Iberia aircraft. The Spanish flag carrier is planning a special flight to chase the solar eclipse at 35,000 feet.
travel.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Europe, the eclipse offers a rare celestial spectacle visible from Spain, with Valencia, Zaragoza, and Barcelona all in the path of totality — an experience not seen from the Iberian Peninsula since 1912.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: 350,000 Haitians Face Deportation as Court Lifts Final TPS Protection
carousel.excerpt: A federal judge confirmed the end of Temporary Protected Status for Haitians, triggering ICE enforcement operations and sending shockwaves through the elder care industry.
carousel.nri_angle: The Supreme Court ruling that courts cannot review TPS terminations sets a sweeping precedent affecting 1.3 million immigrants from 17 countries, fundamentally reshaping the legal landscape for all temporary immigration protections in the United States.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: North Korean Missile Unit Deploys to Russia With Up to 120 Ballistic Missiles for Ukraine Strikes
carousel.excerpt: Ukrainian intelligence says about 90 North Korean personnel are setting up in Russia's Voronezh region, days after a Pyongyang-made missile killed five members of a Ukrainian family.
carousel.image_caption: Russian President Vladimir Putin at an official event. Ukrainian intelligence says North Korea is deploying a missile unit with up to 120 ballistic missiles to Russia's Voronezh region.
carousel.nri_angle: The deepening Russia-North Korea military alliance complicates India's diplomatic balancing act between Moscow and the West, and any escalation in the conflict could further disrupt global energy prices and supply chains affecting the diaspora.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Yash Unveils 'Toxic' Trailer at Bengaluru Event, Confirms Dual Father-Son Role
carousel.excerpt: The KGF star returns after a four-year hiatus with a gangster saga featuring Kiara Advani, Nayanthara, and an ensemble cast, releasing August 26 in IMAX worldwide.
carousel.image_caption: Yash at the trailer launch event for Toxic in Bengaluru. The Kannada star confirmed he plays a dual father-son role in the gangster thriller directed by Geetu Mohandas.
carousel.nri_angle: Yash's KGF franchise established Kannada cinema globally; Toxic's multi-language IMAX release with Lionsgate distribution extends that reach for diaspora audiences.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Brett Lee Names Former KKR Teammate Jacques Kallis as Greatest Cricketer of All Time
carousel.excerpt: The Australian fast bowler picks the South African all-rounder over Sachin Tendulkar and Ricky Ponting, citing their years together at Kolkata Knight Riders.
carousel.nri_angle: Lee's deep IPL connection through KKR and his admiration for Indian cricket culture make this debate resonate with diaspora fans who grew up watching Tendulkar and Kallis compete.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: SpaceX Launches 24 Starlink Satellites From California in 90th Falcon 9 Mission of 2026
carousel.excerpt: SpaceX deployed another batch of Starlink V2 Mini satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base as the company pushes past 10,800 satellites in orbit and maintains its record-setting launch cadence.
carousel.nri_angle: Starlink's global expansion offers improved broadband for diaspora communities in underserved areas, though its entry into India remains pending regulatory approval.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Berkshire Earnings Beat Forecasts as Abel Accelerates Buybacks to $4.5 Billion
carousel.excerpt: Operating profit rose 16% to $12.98 billion in the conglomerate's second quarter under CEO Greg Abel, while share repurchases surged nearly 20-fold from Q1.
carousel.image_caption: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel speaks at the company's annual shareholders meeting in Omaha. The conglomerate reported second-quarter operating earnings of $12.98 billion, a 16% increase from a year earlier.
carousel.nri_angle: Berkshire's renewed capital deployment and portfolio shifts may interest diaspora investors tracking major US conglomerates.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
